replacement.title: Super Admin Dashboard Specification Document
replacement.definition: Produce the requested task-local document describing the proposed Super Admin dashboard without treating the document request itself as authorization to implement the dashboard.

patches.decision_note: The history supports an independent documentation deliverable that is absent from the inventory.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The full book cover is now visible on the landing page, awesome, but can you shrink it back down again, please?

execution.observed_behavior: Although the full cover became visible, it remained larger than the requested small display size.

patches.decision_note: The source verifies visibility but also reports a distinct unresolved post-fix sizing failure.
Message 595 resolves general no-referral ticket issuance but not the earlier unresolved first-mint ticket exception.
Message 672 confirms tickets for ordinary no-code mints but still does not resolve whether the first mint receives a ticket.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yeah, that's okay, as it's a one-off and won't affect anything into the future.

patches.decision_note: After the same-source MODIFY accepts zero tickets for the first mint, the remaining ticket-lifecycle ambiguity is resolved; place RESUME after that MODIFY.
The inconsistent data wipe occurred during activation of a replacement contract and is migration evidence rather than mint-recording evidence.
The source specifies the badge grid arrangement without identifying a mobile context; the change is already represented under REQ_ACHIEVEMENT_BADGES.
The unidentified attachment or omitted content prevents reliable routing of the client's phrase 'Also, this tweak' to a Requirement.
It is unclear whether the later request for mint #1 narrows the earlier obligation to transfer mints #1, #2, and #3 or merely supplies instructions for one transfer.

Chainlink VRF is client-confirmed for prize draws, but the requirement that the same provider select no-referral recipients appears to rely partly on freelancer implementation statements and may overextend client-confirmed scope.
The documentation obligation is supported, but the available history does not safely establish authorization to implement the proposed Super Admin dashboard itself.
